_comment: Pinned country assignments, keyed by Natural Earth NE_ID; 'w' is the world.json id the city gets, 'name' must match the source NAME, 'why' says why. Our map's polygons decide disputed areas (Crimea, Western Sahara, Kosovo, Somaliland, N. Cyprus follow world.json with no pin). Pins here fix cases where the point-in-polygon answer is wrong only because world.json borders are generalised (1:50m, 0.1-unit precision), plus a few reviewed special cases. make-cities.py prints every remaining polygon-vs-ADM0_A3 disagreement; review new ones and pin them here. Phase 2 (U.S. & Canada map): 'na' pins the state/province id a city gets on the NA map (same review rule: make-cities.py prints every polygon-vs-ADM1NAME disagreement); an entry may carry 'w', 'na' or both.
